text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Huh... I won? No way...
I actually went and won the Satsuki Sho~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Everyone told me it was completely impossible,
but once I entered, somehow...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer.
What kind of magic did you use?
choice_data_list: I just did the best I could.
I just gave it everything I had.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I see~. So you managed to adjust things so she could run well even while not in top form.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'm so happy! May I pat your head to show my gratitude?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Because I wanted to do it on the Classic stage♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Because she was so amazing that
'cute' was the last thing on my mind."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: "An achievement like this deserves far more than a simple 'there, there, good girl.' May I praise you with different words?"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Now, shout as loud as you can.
Ready, and...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer, who's a good girl, who's a good girl~♪

I was praised with that super rare compliment,
"What a good kid, what a good kid."

Congratulations on your miraculous Satsuki Sho victory,
Super Creek!
